title: Neural Predicates for Data-Driven Black-Litterman Views on Production ETF Portfolio
source: arXiv:2607.20533 (Jul 2026) — "Grounding Investor Views: Neural Predicates in the Black-Litterman Model" (Florencio)
description: Replace subjective Black-Litterman view specification with neural predicates — a compositional hierarchy of neural networks that process structured financial data to probabilistically generate the P matrix, q vector, and Omega uncertainty matrix of the BL model. Apply to the H026 production portfolio to test whether BL-structured weighting outperforms simple top-1 selection by incorporating calibrated uncertainty from neural predicates rather than fixed conviction.
content_summary: Paper proposes that BL views (P, q, Omega) be generated by a hierarchy of neural predicates: lower-level predicates classify fundamental/technical signals, higher-level predicates compose them into market stances, and the view confidence is derived from predicate output distributions (not hand-specified). Key insight: this makes the BL model fully data-driven while preserving its Bayesian portfolio shrinkage properties. Result: portfolio weights are a shrinkage blend between market-cap equilibrium and neural-derived signal views, with uncertainty-weighted conviction. Adaptation to our stack: (1) train predicates on H026 universe features (12m momentum, 3m/1m momentum, VIX, 200MA signal) to output views on relative outperformance; (2) BL posterior weights replace H026 top-1 allocation; (3) compare against H026 canonical top-1. Expected benefit: better diversification on months where momentum signal is weak/ambiguous (predicates express low confidence → stronger market-cap mean reversion). Variants: Var A uses only momentum predicates; Var B adds macro predicates (VIX, 200MA); Var C stacks with H301 SPY 200MA safety overlay. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 2.610 (H026 baseline with OB filter) AND fewer zero-holding months.
variants: Var A: BL with momentum-only neural predicates (12m/3m/1m signals as predicate inputs)
Var B: BL with momentum + macro predicates (VIX, SPY 200MA, yield curve)
Var C: Var B + H301 SPY 200MA safety overlay (→ BIL when SPY < 200MA)
Var D: Equal-weight BL (flat prior, no predicate — sanity check against market-cap equilibrium)
gate: OOS Sharpe > 2.610 (H346 OB-filter H026 baseline) AND MaxDD not worse than -5%
data_requirements: yfinance ETF prices and market caps for H026 25-asset universe. PyTorch for predicate neural networks (small MLPs, not transformers). PyPortfolioOpt BL implementation already available (portfolio-optimization.md). VIX from FRED VIXCLS. SPY 200MA from yfinance.
implementation_notes: BL model inputs: (1) equilibrium returns pi = lambda * Sigma * w_mktcap (use AUM-weighted market cap for ETFs from yfinance .info); (2) P matrix = predicate outputs indicating which ETFs are expected to outperform; (3) q vector = magnitude of expected outperformance (predicate probability mapped to 0-3% monthly alpha); (4) Omega = predicate confidence-derived uncertainty (high confidence → low Omega diagonal → strong view). Predicate design: logistic regression or 2-layer MLP taking [r_12m, r_3m, r_1m, VIX_normalized, above_200MA] → P(outperform). Train on IS rolling window, use OOS held-out probabilities for BL construction. Key risk: BL posterior is sensitive to tau (scaling parameter) and Omega specification — tune via IS cross-validation before OOS evaluation. Connection to production: if Var C beats H026 standalone and H346, could replace H026 component in production blend.
